look.why: A clear African sky blue that complements the pale slate-grey armor skin and wide savanna silhouette.

size.measure: lip to tail tip, about 4.2 m (body 3.4–4.2 m plus 50–70 cm tail per ADW)

habitat.text: Open grasslands, savannas and bushveld with waterholes and mud wallows across southern and eastern Africa.

diet.text: Short savanna grasses cropped cleanly with its wide, square, flat upper lip.

facts.text: The second-largest land mammal after the elephant; its name comes from Dutch 'wijd' ('wide'), referring to its square grazing lip.
Unlike African elephants, white rhino calves run in front of their mothers rather than behind them.

id.habitat: Padang rumput terbuka, sabana, dan semak belukar dengan kubangan air di Afrika bagian selatan dan timur.
id.diet: Rumput sabana pendek yang dipotong rapi menggunakan bibir atasnya yang lebar dan rata.
facts: Mamalia darat terbesar kedua setelah gajah; namanya berasal dari kata Belanda 'wijd' ('lebar') yang merujuk pada bibirnya yang persegi.
Tidak seperti gajah Afrika, anak badak putih berlari di depan induknya, bukan di belakang.
